v2.gate_B1_outcome: Gate B1 failed at its pre-registered tolerance on 1 check: the MLP index of the Track F row pubmedbert-base-embeddings (0 to 10 publications) moved by 0.29 points, against a tolerance of 0.2. The other 55 index checks (of 56) passed, and all 12 S checks passed (largest difference from v1 0.0013). Gate B1b, a successor gate registered on 2026-11-10 after gate B1 had failed and with knowledge of the seed control (amendment to the plan), passed: averaged over ten probe seeds that had not been run before (5 to 14), with every probe of the index refitted under both mappings, the alias policy changes each of the 28 MLP indices by at most 0.14 points, against the same tolerance of 0.2. The index that failed gate B1 changes by +0.06 points on average (single seeds from -0.18 to +0.26; +0.29 at the benchmark seed). Gate B1 stays recorded as failed, and the v2 values, which use the benchmark seed 0, are unchanged.
v2.metric: T1 per-gene AUROC with average ranks for ties (average-ties-v2); historical double-argsort values on the same logits reported beside

sources.T1: round 17 out-of-fold logits (regenerated embeddings of round 14 where the originals were lost)
sources.T2_T3_T4: round 14 regenerated arrays (R14 gate: 350/366 cells within 0.002 of v1)
sources.GenePT_keyed_rows: every task from the round-17 alias-fallback refits (results/r17/oof_alias; T2 on the released fold columns); the value under the historical symbol mapping is kept in historical_mapping

alias.policy: symbol-only fallback: the GenePT record belongs to the gene whose current symbol equals the key; the secondary gene becomes an absent GenePT row
alias.policy_v2: symbol-only fallback for the seven secondary genes of the GenePT-keyed rows (plan Section 4, Decision 1), extended in the audit of 2026-11-09 to the four alias collisions of GB.Cell-100M and scELMo GPT-3.5 (scripts/r17_alias_ext.py)

index_definition: mean over T1, T2, T4 of 100*(2*AUROC-1); T3 beside for eligible rows; index4 = mean over the four for eligible rows
